questions.question_text: Complete the scatter diagram. The first 6 points have been plotted for you.
What type of correlation is shown on the scatter diagram?
Find the equation of the regression line. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.
Bruno scored 57 in the practical test. Use your answer to part (c) to estimate Bruno’s score for the theory test.

In France, the price of a phone is 310 euros. In Dubai, the price of the same phone is 1185 dirhams. The exchange rate is 1 euro = 3.95 dirhams. Find the difference between the two prices. Give your answer in euros.
Aisha is paid $17.50 per hour. Aisha’s pay is increased to $19.30 per hour. Calculate the percentage increase in Aisha’s pay.
Solve 5 - 2x > 3x + 7.
Jeanne invests $2000 at a rate of 3.5% per year simple interest. Calculate the interest earned at the end of 8 years.
Karim invests $2000 at a rate of 2.8% per year compound interest. Calculate the interest earned at the end of 10 years.
Lauren invests $2000 at a rate of 3.1% per year compound interest. At the end of n years, the value of the investment is $3066.56 correct to the nearest cent. Calculate the value of n.
The diagram shows a trapezium, ABCD. AD = DC = CB and AB = 23 cm. The perimeter of the trapezium is 62 cm. Calculate the area of the trapezium.
Calculate angle BAD.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -5 and 5, where f(x) = 2^x / (x + 2).
Find the coordinates of the local minimum.
Solve f(x) = 3.
Write down a value of k for which f(x) = k has only one solution.
Find the range of values of k for which f(x) = k has no solutions.
ABC is a field on level ground. B is 178 m due east of A. The bearing of C from A is 158°. The bearing of C from B is 237°. Calculate the length of CB.
Calculate the area of the field ABC.
y is inversely proportional to x^3. When x = 2, y = 2.5. Find y in terms of x.
Find the value of x when y = 20000.
p is directly proportional to y^2. When x = \sqrt[3]{2}, p = 1200. Find p in terms of x.

The table shows some information about the heights, in cm, of 120 plants. All of these plants have a height greater than 12 cm. Maximum: 80, Median: 48, Lower quartile: 34, Interquartile range: 26. Use this information to draw a cumulative frequency diagram. The first point has been plotted for you.

Transformation A is a rotation 90° clockwise about the origin. Transformation B is a translation by the vector (3 / -1). Describe fully the single transformation equivalent to transformation A followed by transformation B.
A is the point (-3, 2) and B is the point (7, -3). Find the equation of the line AB.
C is a point on AB, and the ratio AC : CB = 3 : 2. Find the coordinates of C.

OAD and OBC are sectors of circles each with centre O. The sector angle is 35°. The radius of the smaller circle is 15 m. The radius of the larger circle is 25 m. Calculate the area of the shaded region.
Calculate the perimeter of the shaded region.
The diagram shows a sketch of the graph of a quadratic function y = f(x). The graph passes through (-1, 0), (3, 0) and (0, -6). Find f(x).
The graph of y = f(x) is mapped onto the graph of y = g(x) by a translation vector (1 / 0). Find g(x) in terms of x.
